selection: Synopsis Section 4.9 initial weights and Section 4.9 confidence tiers (>85% high, 70-85% medium, <70% low). TF-IDF + ResNet-50 were selected from the four-way pilot comparison in evaluation/results.json, where all combinations tied on validation F1 and deterministic order picked TF-IDF + ResNet. The pilot-tuned weight variant (text 0.2 / image 0.4, thresholds 0.8 / 0.9) is recorded there as an experiment only: the constructed pilot fails the research-readiness gate, so it must not override the synopsis defaults in production.
missing_data_policy: Components with no evidence on one or both reports (no photograph; no brand and no colour) are dropped and the remaining weights are renormalised. Dropped components are stored per match.
temporal_rule: A found report dated more than 1 day before the lost report is impossible and is never stored as a match.
image_calibration: Raw image cosine is rescaled above each model's chance level: (cos - chance) / (1 - chance), clamped to [0, 1]. Chance is the median cosine between photos of different items (the 120 label-0 pairs of evaluation/pilot/dataset.json) with the pinned models: ResNet-50 0.275, CLIP 0.568, histogram 0.574. Without it, unrelated photos scored 0.25-0.57 and added unearned points to every pair; identical photos still score 1.
